item.tib: smug mo srid pa rgyal mo'i gsang bskang
item.coloph: gsang ba thugs kyi gzer bu'i gnad bskang (skong) zhes bya ba/ grub thob stong rgyung mthu chen gyis mdzad pa/ bdag 'dra drung mu ha ra la zhal mjal ba'i skal pa nod nas gsungs pa dge'o/ phran rong btsun dge sbyongs bsod nams tshul dbang gis ri sul du sug bris bgyis pa'i gnyan khrod 'grim pa'i cha rkyen du gyur cig/
